items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: I have a very dear friend of mine. He's from New Orleans, Sidney Bashir.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's what the guy said when he wrote the book. He says, this is not the Bible. Send me your correction. You know? Mm-hmm. And that's right. They need to check up on everything kept.
Well, the tunes is right for us, haven't you? Yeah. Oh, yeah. Maybe they might have the right dates on. Have you a record here by Sidney Bashir and Muggsy Big Four? That's a plenty?
I think I can find it on the 30 on these here. Oh, they're not strong. I made about a 12 inch. We might have it.
